validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <final id="a">
    <donedata>
      <param name="both" expr="1" location="x"/>
      <param name="neither"/>
    </donedata>
  </final>
</scxml>

notes: a parameter needs a name and exactly one value source: `expr` evaluates a value, `location` reads a data-model location

diagnostics.message: param requires exactly one of `expr` or `location`

diagnostics.help: use `expr` for a value expression or `location` for a data-model location
